_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Small pure-C# utility mod (16 tracked files, no card JSON or localization tables), so 4 modules following the code's responsibilities rather than 5-15. `module_map.py check RepeatAction` must exit 0.

modules.name: Action Replay
modules.summary: ActionPatch (the v2 native-dispatch repeat loop) and RunHooks, what a run hands a requirements-unmet subscriber.

modules.name: Sequences and Presets
modules.summary: Recorded action sequences played back by the count (Sequences) and named run-setting presets (Presets).

modules.name: Cross-mod Bridges
modules.summary: UtilityBeltLockBridge: a run skips cards Utility Belt has locked.

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, config and count keys, the player toast texts, project files and docs.
